Physical equation partial_t f_i=sum_j[c_ij/m_i^2 div(A[f_j] grad f_i)-c_ij/(m_i m_j)div(f_i(b*f_j))]. Conditional criteria apply on the actual local strong weighted-L2 solution class. Auxiliary P_tau^i=exp((tau/m_i)Delta) uses HEAT time tau, separate from physical collision time. Particle numbers and mass-weighted detailed balance remain explicit. New unconditional statements hold on every existing finite maximal classical interval of the SAME exact finite-mass two-species Coulomb equation,with all c_ii>0,actual n_i and initial kinetic energy Ekin,entropyH0 and M21(0) retained. Zhu2512.17905v1 cross |gamma|<=sqrt(8) excludes Coulomb -3; Junne-Winter-Yoldas2512.17082v1 local theory and compensated infinite-ion theorem are distinct, with its extra condition retained. No pending unidentified fulltext is a premise/recovery route. E_s has no proved collision growth/sign bound, and full heat-range differentiation is formal until endpoint estimates close. Generic two-point covariance negativity is not a physical product-score counterexample. Integral fractional control does NOT substitute for the supremum continuation criterion. The mixed exponentsr=1/s,q=3/(3-2s) satisfy2/r+3/q=3,where the direct reaction-energy argument needs2; varying s in this method does not close the deficit.
